mapper.insert: insert into note_comment ( note_comment_no, note_no, project_member_no, note_comment_content, note_comment_ctime, note_comment_utime ) values ( #{noteCommentNo}, #{noteNo}, #{projectMemberNo}, #{noteCommentContent}, systimestamp, null )
mapper.select: select nc.note_comment_no as noteCommentNo, nc.note_no as noteNo, nc.project_member_no as projectMemberNo, nc.note_comment_content as noteCommentContent, nc.note_comment_ctime as noteCommentCtime, nc.note_comment_utime as noteCommentUtime, e.emp_no as empNo, e.emp_name as empName, e.emp_dept_no as empDeptNo, e.emp_position_no as empPositionNo from note_comment nc inner join project_member pm on nc.project_member_no = pm.project_member_no inner join emp e on pm.emp_no = e.emp_no where nc.note_no = #{noteNo} order by nc.note_comment_ctime asc
